summary: This bill establishes the New York-New Jersey Watershed Restoration Program and a related grant program to coordinate and fund activities for the restoration and protection of the New York-New Jersey Watershed, focusing on fish and wildlife habitat, water quality, climate resilience, and community engagement, particularly in environmental justice communities.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a program and grant program for the restoration and protection of the New York-New Jersey Watershed, focusing on fish and wildlife habitat, water quality, and the use of natural climate solutions and infrastructure. Its primary purpose is environmental protection and restoration.
